  Navigate:         pwd  cd  ls  open  file  stat  du  df  find  mdfind
  Files:            mkdir  rmdir  touch  cp  mv  rm  ln  chmod  zip  unzip  tar  pbcopy  pbpaste
  Read:             cat  head  tail  less  more  wc  grep  diff  sort  uniq  cut  tr  tee  xargs
  Edit:             nano  code  open -a TextEdit file
  Calculate:        echo  printf  seq  expr  bc  python3 (install the command line developer tools first)
  System:           date  cal  uptime  whoami  id  hostname  uname  sw_vers  sysctl  system_profiler  ps  top  kill  killall
  Network:          ifconfig  ipconfig  networksetup  ping  curl  nslookup  traceroute (the practice version has no network, so results are fake)
  Shell:            alias  export  history  which  type  man  clear  exit  sleep  true  false  yes  source
  Version control:  git (install the command line developer tools first)

Shortcuts: Tab completes, Up/Down arrows find commands you typed before, Ctrl+R searches history, Ctrl+C interrupts, Ctrl+A / Ctrl+E jump to the start / end of the line, Ctrl+U / Ctrl+K delete everything before / after the cursor, Ctrl+L clears the screen.

@file:terminal-cmds.js.ls（dir）：列出資料夾裡的東西。-Force 連隱藏的也列出，-Recurs: ls (dir): lists what is in a folder. -Force also lists hidden items; -Recurse also lists the folders inside.
@file:terminal-cmds.js.cd：走到另一個資料夾。cd .. 往外一層，cd ~ 回到家，路徑有空格要加引: cd: moves to another folder. cd .. goes up one level, cd ~ goes to your home folder, and a path with spaces needs quotes: cd "Saved Games".
@file:terminal-cmds.js.pwd：顯示現在所在的資料夾。: pwd: shows the folder you are in now.
@file:terminal-cmds.js.mkdir：建立新資料夾，並列出它。: mkdir: creates a new folder and lists it.
@file:terminal-cmds.js.mv：搬移東西。mv 東西 資料夾 是搬進去；目的地不存在時，會直接改名。: mv: moves things. mv item folder moves the item into the folder; if the destination does not exist, the item is simply renamed.
@file:terminal-cmds.js.cp：複製東西。複製資料夾要加 -Recurse。: cp: copies things. Add -Recurse to copy a folder.
@file:terminal-cmds.js.rm：刪除東西。沒有資源回收筒，刪了就沒了；資料夾要加 -Recurse。: rm: deletes things. There is no Recycle Bin, so what you delete is gone; add -Recurse for a folder.
@file:terminal-cmds.js.cat：顯示檔案的內容。: cat: shows the contents of a file.
